profile_text.body:
Beautiful.ai is a presentation software company founded in 2016 and positioned, per its own site, as an AI presentation platform built for enterprise teams. The company describes its product as keeping decks on-brand and consistent across an organization, with features including over 300 auto-aligning Smart Slide layouts, shared brand themes covering colors, fonts, and logos, and a library of data slides such as charts, graphs, timelines, and diagrams. The site claims teams can reach work-ready decks ten times faster using these tools.

The company's core AI feature, called Create with AI, is described as a context-aware workflow that guides users from an initial prompt or document through a text-first outline stage before generating finished slides, with the stated goal of making iteration controllable rather than dependent on a single generated output. The site cites customer examples including Paciolan, Cvent, and IDC, each of which it says cut presentation design time by 75 percent or described meaningfully reduced production time after adopting the platform. Pricing includes a 14-day free trial with full feature access, along with plans for individuals, small teams, startups, and enterprise deployments.

The site's held facts confirm Beautiful.ai is tracked under the Slides and Presentations product category, with its primary product listed as presentation generation. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are present in the available data.
